title: INGEST Preservation Record
description: The immutable record of a preserved capture. The capture itself may live outside the brain; the digest is what binds it.

attestationId.description: No preservation record may exist without one. Processing an unattested capture is IN-01.

storeLocation.description: Where the preserved bytes live. May be outside the brain.

verified.description: The post-copy digest comparison. A record with verified false may not be cited.

derivedFrom.description: Set on an edited version, such as a release cut, naming the preservationId of the original.
